assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE standalone achievement icon for a friendly retro farm sheep game, part of an established cream-white sheep and warm brown outline pixel-art collection.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no scenery.
Style/medium: crisp flat 2D pixel art on a 48x48 logical grid enlarged with nearest-neighbor; chunky clean square pixel clusters, limited palette, cream-white wool, peach-pink faces, thick dark orange-brown outlines, warm golden highlights and a few green leaf accents. Only solid flat colors. Cute and cheerful with strong clear silhouettes readable at 28 pixels.
Composition: one tightly grouped square cutout centered in a square image, every part fully visible, about 12 percent truly transparent margin all around. Keep detail sparse and bold, the sheep is the dominant subject.
Avoid: text, typography, letters, digits, labels, numbers, logo, watermark, icon border, badge circle, background, ground shadow, detached confetti, blur, anti-aliasing, gradients, glow, 3D, shiny render, complex tiny patterns.
Subject: A cheerful cream-white sheep wearing a simple little BLUE scarf and carrying ONE small warm-brown lantern in its hoof. Inside the lantern's clear simple square window is ONE golden five-point STAR shape as a solid bright-gold flat color, with no diffuse light or glow. Sheep and lantern directly next to each other and form a single tight compact square silhouette. Friendly tiny smiling peach-pink face. Meaning: starlight runs with me.
Text: none.
